visualNarrative.action: A white answer line draws out at center-right, sitting below and angled slightly below the gold hairline — your answer at its starting heading.

visualNarrative.action: A second YES badge joins; the drift compounds. A third YES follows.
visualNarrative.meaning: Repetition adds drift instead of returning it — fatigue accumulates.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Three staggered badges on the right side; each arrives lower than the last; single gold accent on the reference hairline.

visualNarrative.action: Gold label 'DRIFT — NEVER RECOVERED' fades in bottom-right; frame settles.
visualNarrative.meaning: The residue is a permanent deficit — the heading does not reset on its own.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Static frame: one gold hairline at top-right, three secondary YES badges, one gold drift label; headline left; clear composition.

storyboard.compositionIntent: Left text, right objects: headline block left-aligned at 8% margin; gold hairline at topRight, answer line at center-right, three YES badges staggered vertically at right, drift label at bottomRight. Bottom 18% reserved for subtitles. ~60% negative space. Gold only on hairline and drift label.

One gold headline word TIRES, one gold hairline, one gold label; three secondary YES badges; seven elements, single accent.
forbiddenInterpretations: A person, figure, or slumped character — the line, badges and label carry the fatigue.

storyboard.noveltyIntent: Fatigue is measured as permanent angular drift of a rigid answer line: every YES stays physically on the frame as a badge marking the downward step, and the drift label names the permanent gap — no vessel, bar, grid, loop, or sagging rope.
